units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 2:3">Targ. Y. II, Ex. II, 3</cite> <he>ג׳ נהרא</he> river-side (Y. I <cite ref="C00787"><he>גֵּיף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 13:12">Targ. Job XIII, 12</cite> <he>גב טינא</he> a body (lump) of clay.—
<cite ref="Chullin 47b">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A00236"><he>אגבא</he></cite> on top, opp. <he>מגואי</he> inside, below.

<cite ref="Yoma 78a:10">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ דכרעא הוה</he> it was the back (dorsum) of the foot, cmp. <cite ref="C00031">preced.</cite> <he>גב רגל</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="C00090"><he>גַּבִּין</he></cite>, <he>גַּבֵּי־</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 31:10">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXI, 10</cite>; a. e.—[<he>גבייה</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:1">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>, some ed., read <he>גביים</he>, v. preced.].—<he>עַל גַּב</he>, <he>עַל גַּבֵּי</he> as <cite ref="C00031">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 21:3">Targ. II Chr. XXI, 3</cite> <he>ע״ג קרקע</he>, v. <cite ref="A00235"><he>אַגַּב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 1:17">Targ. Y. II, Lev. I, 17</cite>; a. e.—<he>ע״ג ידא</he> upon one’s hand; <he>כע״ג י׳</he> (<cite ref="K00098"><he>כד</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00489"><he>כִּיד</he></cite>) as upon one’s hand, i.e. exposed to danger.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 13:14">Targ. Job. XIII, 14</cite>; a. fr.—Also ellipt. <he>כעל גב</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 9:17">Targ. Jud. IX, 17</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 21:9">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXI, 9</cite>.—With suffix of pers. pron.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 19:4">Targ. Job XIX, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>יתיב גַּבֵּיה</he> he sat with him.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Ib.</cite> <he>גַּבְּכוֹן</he> in your country. Y. Ned. VI, 40ᵃ sent letters <he>גבי ר׳ יצחק</he> through R. &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <cite ref="C00114"><he>גַּבָּן</he></cite> (thus we read) in our country.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:21">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ליתי … גַּבָּאי</he> let Ezekiel come to me.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35:2">Gen. R. s. 35</cite> <he>מן גַּבֵּיה ועד גַּבִּי</he> from those with him &c., from his generation to mine.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:12">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>זיל לגבי דר׳ וכ׳</he> go to see R. &c.; a. v. fr.
